title: Russia arming drones with propaganda, cyber threats, Ukraine's drone commander warns
summary: Ukrainian soldiers on Nov. 4 shot down a Russian Shahed drone carrying an unusual payload: "a bundle of propaganda leaflets from the enemy," Robert "Madyar" Brovdi reported.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,599,390 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,380 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: Russian drone attacks injure 4 in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts, spark fires at infrastructure facilities
summary: Ukraine's State Emergency Service confirmed at around 7 a.m. local time that logistics infrastructure had been targeted in Kyiv Oblast.

title: Drone attack sparks fires at industrial facilities in Russia's Ryazan, oil refinery reportedly targeted
summary: The Ryazan refinery, operated by Russia's state-controlled oil giant Rosneft, has an annual processing capacity of around 17 million metric tons of crude oil.
